summary: Layer 1B expands the public-market universe around AI/data-center electrical power delivery. Reference leaders remain Vertiv, Eaton, GE Vernova, Quanta, and Hubbell, but this underfollowed pass surfaces companies one or two steps away from GPUs: engineered switchgear and power-control rooms, electrical contracting and data-center build execution, cable/conduit/cable-management suppliers, and connection/protection hardware. The strongest direct node evidence in this pass is Powell Industries for switchgear/power distribution and nVent for data-center electrical connection/protection. IES Holdings and Atkore are more second-order: they may benefit from hyperscale construction and electrical infrastructure intensity, but require tighter verification of data-center revenue mix, backlog quality, pricing, and capacity constraints.
